prompts.name: macbook-real
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium technology website product cutout. Primary request: A single extremely thin sky-blue aluminum laptop, open at 100 degrees, three-quarter view from slightly above, full device visible including keyboard, trackpad, polished chamfered edges, subtle speaker and key details. The display shows fluid blue satin abstract wallpaper, no text, no icons. Style: photorealistic premium studio product photography, physically accurate materials, fine surface texture, sharp optical glass reflections, natural subtle imperfections, no cartoon illustration. Lighting: broad softbox key light with controlled studio rim highlights, dimensional depth, restrained luxury advertising aesthetic. Composition: centered isolated object, entire silhouette visible, generous clean margin, landscape canvas. Background: genuinely transparent alpha; no floor, no background, no shadow baked outside the object, no text, no watermark.
